productPriority: Göteborg core-loop first. Feature breadth later.
purpose: Keep FOLKOOP cooperation, outcome and civic-routing semantics compatible with the SDCF type-safety model without adding RDF/OWL/SHACL to the production runtime.

mappings.meaning: Intent-bearing cooperation workspace and lifecycle context.
mappings.note: A cooperation row is not identical to any single SDCF class; its kind, description and lifecycle determine which SDCF roles are relevant.

mappings.meaning: People participating in a cooperation with owner/member roles.
mappings.note: Membership is contextual participation, not a permanent property of the person.

mappings.meaning: Planned work and task execution state.
mappings.note: todo/doing describe planned or ongoing work. done is a claim about task completion, not independent proof of a real-world outcome.

mappings.meaning: Supplier alternatives for a shared purchase.
mappings.note: Offer data remains provider-supplied unless independently verified.

mappings.meaning: Recorded selection of one purchase alternative.
mappings.note: The selected offer must remain traceable to the alternatives actually considered.
ordered/delivered/done are coordination states and may be self-reported; they are not automatically externally verified outcomes.
An activity record establishes that FOLKOOP recorded an event; it is not by itself evidence that the corresponding real-world effect occurred.

mappings.meaning: Source and freshness metadata for civic information.
mappings.note: Source metadata can support a claim, but the source record and the claim remain separate.
A resolver result is a routing recommendation backed by a source identifier; it is not the authority's own legal decision.

mappings.meaning: Possible future algorithmic recommendation of a person, resource or opportunity.
mappings.note: No current pilot capability is upgraded to an SDCF prediction merely by this bridge.

guards.name: done_is_not_confirmed_outcome
guards.rule: A UI/database done state must not be reported as an independently confirmed real-world Outcome without separate confirmation or evidence.

guards.name: activity_is_not_real_world_evidence
guards.rule: A cooperation activity-log event proves only that FOLKOOP recorded the event or state change, not that the external effect occurred.

guards.name: source_is_not_claim
guards.rule: City source metadata and a claim inferred from that source must remain distinguishable.

guards.name: routing_is_not_authority_decision
guards.rule: A FOLKOOP civic-routing result must not be presented as an official authority decision unless a real authority integration produced that decision.

guards.name: organic_and_facilitated_matches_remain_distinct
guards.rule: Operator-facilitated matches must remain distinguishable from organic product discovery and matching.

guards.name: unknown_is_not_false
guards.rule: Missing evidence or missing verification must not be converted into a negative factual claim.

guards.name: recommendation_requires_provenance
guards.rule: Any future algorithmic recommendation must retain method/model version, generation time and an inspectable basis.

guards.name: no_sensitive_matching_by_default
guards.rule: Political beliefs, religion, health, migration status and other sensitive categories must not be inferred or used for matching by default.

guards.name: ontology_is_not_user_interface
guards.rule: SDCF terminology must not become a user-facing requirement for ordinary FOLKOOP participants.

guards.name: no_runtime_semantic_stack_before_evidence
guards.rule: The Göteborg pilot must not be delayed by adding RDF, OWL, SHACL or an SDCF graph database to the production runtime without a demonstrated product or safety need.

futureTriggers.condition: structured real-world outcome verification becomes a demonstrated pilot need
futureTriggers.preferredImplementation: small relational outcome/confirmation tables first; semantic export later

futureTriggers.condition: algorithmic or AI matching is introduced
City routing adds consequential inference or automated submission
FOLKOOP becomes multi-city with interoperable Nodes or external partners
futureTriggers.preferredImplementation: versioned adapter/export layer rather than replacing the operational PostgreSQL model
